cards.audioText: What factors can affect an aircraft's center of gravity at takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素会影响航空器起飞时的重心？
cards.referenceText: Takeoff centre of gravity is affected by the distribution of passengers, baggage, cargo, fuel and operating items. Last-minute changes, incorrect loading data, fuel transfer or loading in the wrong compartment can shift it from the planned value. The crew verifies the final load information and ensures both weight and balance remain within the approved envelope.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起飞重心受旅客、行李、货物、燃油和运行物品分布的影响。最后一分钟变更、装载数据错误、燃油传输或货物装入错误舱位，都可能使重心偏离计划值。机组应核实最终装载信息，并确保重量和平衡都保持在批准包线内。

cards.audioText: How can an excessively forward center of gravity affect an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 重心过度靠前会如何影响航空器？
cards.referenceText: An excessively forward centre of gravity increases the nose-down tendency and the control force or trim needed to raise the nose. It can reduce takeoff rotation and landing flare capability, increase stall speed in some conditions and add load to the nose gear. If it is outside the approved envelope, the aircraft must not depart even if total weight is within limits.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重心过于靠前会增加低头趋势，以及抬头所需的操纵力或配平量。它可能削弱起飞抬轮和着陆拉平能力，在某些条件下提高失速速度，并增加前起落架载荷。如果重心超出批准包线，即使总重量仍在限制内，飞机也不得起飞。
